BRICS Summit Concludes with Focus on Trade, Cooperation, and Bilateral Meetings

The 18th BRICS Summit concluded with leaders discussing global trade tensions, unilateral tariffs, and non-tariff measures. Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced initiatives including a startup fund, digital agriculture, a supply chain framework, and an integrated early warning system for global crises. He also outlined four pillars for India's BRICS presidency and stated that BRICS' relevance is growing. The summit also saw Prime Minister Modi hold 15 bilateral meetings. Separately, Delhi Traffic Police announced diversions due to the summit.
